svg.title: Eliminating a bug class instead of fixing a bug
svg.desc: Before: the field was about twenty positioned div elements using percentages, fixed rotation angles and fixed pixels at once, squashed to 4.8:1 so the foul lines and bases pulled apart from the diamond. After: the identical drawing as one inline SVG with viewBox 0 0 100 100, locked square, in the same 0 to 100 coordinate space every hit location is stored in.

svg.text: When a bug comes from two representations of one truth drifting apart, unify the representations — do not correct the drift.
